regime_context: The regime is staged low-real-yield engineering plus strategic re-industrialization: the Fed under Warsh pre-loads hawkish inflation-mandate credibility, while Treasury/Bessent suppresses the front end structurally. Consensus reads the hawkish tape as pure tightening; revealed interest leans toward managing optics now and preserving data-gated easing optionality after the midterms, even as the Iran re-escalation sharpens stagflation risk.
regime_context_zh: 当前体制是分阶段推进的低实际利率工程叠加战略性再工业化：Warsh 领导下的美联储预先积累鹰派通胀目标信誉，同时 Bessent 领导的财政部在结构上压低短端利率。市场共识把鹰派信号单纯解读为紧缩；而所显露的偏好更倾向于当下管理预期、中期选举后保留由数据触发的宽松期权——尽管伊朗局势再度升级使滞胀风险更加突出。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran ceasefire collapse is a realized upside oil shock; energy was already the top ETF-inflow sector and the rotation re-primes on Hormuz/transit headlines. Admin incentives favor higher energy prices as inflation-gated easing optics while defense/haven bids persist.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂已兑现为油价上行冲击；能源本就是 ETF 资金流入最多的板块，霍尔木兹海峡与运输数据相关头条会再次点燃轮动。政府在通胀门槛式宽松的叙事下，对能源价格上行有利益偏好，同时国防与避险买盘持续存在。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Rotation map: energy was top ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on the conflict
Market state: Reflation quad, inflation_score 0.4, stagflationary split sharpened
theses.dissent: Ceasefires are two-sided; any rapid de-escalation or Hormuz transit normalization collapses the risk premium and XLE momentum, especially after the realized spike.
theses.dissent_zh: 停火具有两面性；若迅速降级或霍尔木兹海峡运输恢复正常，风险溢价和 XLE 动能将迅速瓦解，尤其是在已兑现的急涨之后。

falsifier.text: XLE trails SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date without a renewed Hormuz escalation.
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查截止日之前，XLE 在没有新一轮霍尔木兹海峡局势升级的情况下落后 SPY 达到 5% 或以上。

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Warsh's hawkish credibility-banking plus a >70% September-hike probability and strong-dollar bridge raise real-rate pressure near-term; gold is range-bound $4,044-4,200 and lacks a bullish catalyst unless the labor crack widens first. Recent track record shows two GLD underweight hits.
theses.thesis_zh: Warsh 积累鹰派信誉的努力、9 月加息概率超过 70%，加之强势美元作为过渡，短期内推升实际利率压力；黄金在 4,044–4,200 区间震荡，除非就业裂口首先扩大，否则缺乏上行动力。近期记录显示两条 GLD 低配均命中。
evidence: CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike
DXY rose to 13-mo high before easing; gold range $4,044-4,200
track_record: two recent GLD underweight outcomes were hits
theses.dissent: The Mar-a-Lago tail, any explicit dollar-weakening shift, or a labor-driven pivot could make gold the cleanest winner, breaking the range to the upside.
theses.dissent_zh: Mar-a-Lago 尾部风险、任何明确的弱美元转向，或就业驱动的政策转向，都可能让黄金成为最干净的多头，向上突破当前区间。

falsifier.text: GLD outperforms SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date without a labor-market shock.
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查截止日之前，GLD 在没有劳动力市场冲击的情况下跑赢 SPY 达到 5% 或以上。

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: Advanced-chip tariff and Section 301 replacement are policy intent independent of the court strike-down; onshoring bid persists contingent on the Section 301 handoff completing cleanly. Industrial policy steers capital to domestic semiconductors; prior SMH overweight hit.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税与 301 条款替代方案是独立于法院裁决的政策意图；只要 301 条款交接顺利完成，本土化买盘就会持续。产业政策引导资金流向国内半导体；此前 SMH 超配曾命中。
evidence: China theater: SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind tariff-protection premium; Section 301 replacement ~12.5% pending
Rotation map: domestic semiconductors/fabs proxies SMH, SOXX under FACT mechanism
track_record: 2026-07-10 SMH overweight was a hit
theses.dissent: If the Section 301 handoff stalls after the July 24 Section 122 expiry, the protection premium gap opens and SMH can de-rate against SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 若 301 条款在 7 月 24 日 Section 122 到期后交接受阻，保护溢价缺口将打开，SMH 可能相对 SPY 价值回撤。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date and the Section 301 replacement remains unresolved.
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查截止日之前，SMH 落后 SPY 达到 5% 或以上，且 301 条款替代方案仍未落地。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Front-end suppression does not extend to duration: real 10y at 2.29% plus a hike-majority market and Warsh's hawkish line keep long-end pressure. A post-midterm easing pivot is possible but remains inflation-gated, so duration is unattractive against SPY near-term. Recent TLT underweight hit.
theses.thesis_zh: 短端压制无法延伸至久期：实际 10 年期利率 2.29%、市场预计加息为主，加之 Warsh 的鹰派表态，长端压力仍存。中期选举后的宽松转向虽有可能，但仍以通胀为条件，因此久期资产近期相对 SPY 不具吸引力。此前 TLT 低配曾命中。
evidence: Market state: real 10y 2.29%, Sept hike >70% probability
Fed path gap: -14bp market vs dot, market more dovish but Warsh holds hawkish line
track_record: 2026-08-01 TLT underweight was a hit
theses.dissent: Treasury buybacks and yield suppression could extend out the curve, and a labor-crack-driven pivot would compress long-end yields sharply, making TLT a top outperformer.
theses.dissent_zh: 财政部的回购操作与收益率压制可能向长端延伸；若就业裂口触发政策转向，长端收益率将大幅压缩，TLT 反而会成为最强跑赢品种。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date without a formal Treasury buyback expansion into long-dated tenors.
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查截止日之前，TLT 在没有财政部正式将回购扩展至长期限的情况下跑赢 SPY 达到 5% 或以上。
